name: web-sign-up-split-screen-with-black-quote-panel-and-laptop-mockup
title: Split sign-up: a white 'Create an account' form with social buttons on the left and a black striped panel with a quote and a cropped laptop on the right
whatItIs: A two-panel screen: at left a white area with a light title, Google and Apple buttons, an 'or' divider, first and last name fields, email, a masked password with an eye icon, two checkboxes and a wide black Submit; at right a black panel with vertical grey light streaks, a round avatar with name and role, a large white quote and a cropped grey laptop showing an inbox.
whatItMeans: Trustworthy and focused; a quote and product peek beside the form add confidence.
techniques: Split the screen into form and story.
Place social sign-in above the form.
End with a full-width black button.
Show a cropped laptop on the dark panel.

vocabulary.definition: A form on one side and marketing on the other.
Buttons to register via Google or Apple.
A dark area with a testimonial.
A device cut off by the panel edge.
